Milestones achieved
   • Commission Staff filed a discussion draft on August 25, 2025.
   • Commission Staff hosted a workshop on September 2, 2025.
   • The Commission approved the proposal for publication on September 18, 2025.
   • Initial comments to the proposal for publication were received on October 17, 2025.
   • Reply comments to the proposal for publication were received on October 31, 2025.
   • Commission Staff synthesized 328 pages of initial comments and 153 pages of reply comments.
   • Commission Staff summarized initial and reply comments, drafted commission responses, and incorporated changes into a recommended
       adoption order.
   • Commission Staff presented a recommended adoption order for the Commission’s consideration at the February 20, 2026 open meeting.
   • The Commission provided feedback and guidance to Commission Staff at the February 20, 2026 open meeting.
   • Commission Staff developed proposed redline changes to proposed rule language in response to Commission feedback at the
       February 20, 2026 open meeting.
   • Commission Staff presented a recommended adoption order and proposed redline changes for the Commission’s consideration at the
       March 12, 2026 open meetings.
   • At the March 12, 2026 open meeting, the Commission considered whether additional changes should be made to the proposed rule
       language before adoption.
   • Commission Staff presented a recommended adoption order and proposed redline changes for the Commission’s consideration at the March
       26, 2026 open meeting
   • The Commission adopted the recommended adoption order and proposed redline changes at the March 26, 2026 open meeting.
Milestones remaining
   • None.

Milestones achieved
   • Commission Staff filed questions for comment on September 12, 2025.
   • Comments to questions for comment received on October 10, 2025.
   • Commission Staff synthesized 247 pages of comments.
   • Commission Staff filed a first discussion draft on December 1, 2025.
   • Comments to the first discussion draft were received on December 19, 2025.
   • Commission Staff synthesized 727 pages of comments.
   • Commission Staff filed a second discussion draft on January 2, 2026.
   • Commission Staff hosted a workshop on January 9, 2026.
   • Comments to the second discussion draft received were received on January 16, 2026.
   • Commission Staff synthesized 256 pages of comments.
   • Commission Staff presented a proposal for publication for the Commission’s consideration at the February 20, 2026 open meeting.
   • At the February 20, 2026 open meeting, the Commission discussed whether changes should be made to the proposal for publication before
       approval.
   • Commission Staff presented a proposal for publication for the Commission’s consideration at the March 12, 2026 open meeting.
   • The Commission approved the proposal for publication with changes at the March 12, 2026 open meeting.
   • Comments to the proposal for publication were received on April 17, 2026.
Milestones remaining
    •   Commission Staff will synthesize 1,210 pages of comments.
    •   Commission Staff will summarize comments, draft commission responses, and incorporate changes into a recommended adoption order.
    •   Commission Staff will present a recommended adoption order for the Commission’s consideration at an open meeting in late summer.
*The estimated timelines were revised to allow time to incorporate ERCOT’s batch study.

Milestones achieved
   • Commission Staff filed a first set of questions for comment on August 5, 2025.
   • Comments to the first set of questions were received on September 9, 2025.
   • Commission Staff synthesized 247 pages of comments.
   • Commission Staff filed a request for information to transmission and distribution utilities on October 17, 2025.
   • Commission Staff filed a second set of questions for comment filed on October 28, 2025.
   • Commission Staff hosted a workshop on November 10, 2025.
   • Responses to request for information were received on November 14, 2025.
   • Comments to the second set of questions were received on November 25, 2025.
   • Commission Staff synthesized 325 pages of comments.
   • Commission Staff conducted analysis of the four coincident peak methodology and alternative methodologies.
   • Commission Staff filed a memorandum on March 16, 2026, requesting public comment on draft recommendations and a draft report
       summarizing Commission Staff’s analysis of the four coincident peak methodology and alternative methodologies.
   • Comments to the draft recommendations and draft report were received on April 13, 2026.
   • Commission Staff synthesized 336 pages of comments to the draft recommendations and draft report.
   • Commission Staff finalized its recommendations and report to the Commission.
   • Commission Staff presented its finalized recommendations and report for the Commission’s consideration at the May 7, 2026 open meeting.
   • Based on the Commission’s feedback and guidance, Commission Staff initiated a rulemaking project to implement the policy direction
       provided by the Commission.
Milestones remaining
   •   None.
*Project No. 58000, Rulemaking to Update Wholesale and IOU Retail Transmission Cost Recovery in the ERCOT Region, is the rulemaking project implementing the
recommendations developed as a result of the evaluation conducted in this project.

   •   Commission Staff will present a recommended adoption order for the commission’s consideration at an open meeting in December 2026.
